facts.fact: Minister Zerrouki told the APN that Algeria is connected to the global internet through four submarine cable systems, SEA-ME-WE 4, Medex, Orval (Oran-Valence) and Alval (Alger-Valence), plus an Alger-Palma cable; the document names Oran and Algiers as separate cable origins but does not use the words landing station.

note: Medusa (service due early 2028) and the Medex extension (works to June 2026) are not yet in service; international capacity above 10.2 Tbit/s is bandwidth only and is not a fact.
